# Release allowlist ("wishlist") for the public Colnect-API-Client package.
#
# Every path listed here is copied — as a snapshot — into the public repository
# on each release. Anything NOT listed here never leaves this private repo, so
# this is an allowlist (default-deny), which is the safer model for publishing.
#
# Rules:
#   * One path per line, relative to the repository root.
#   * A path may be a file or a directory (directories are copied recursively).
#   * Blank lines and lines beginning with '#' are ignored.
#   * Absolute paths and '..' are rejected by the publisher.
#
# Deliberately EXCLUDED — do NOT add these unless you really mean to publish them:
#   README.md                          -> the public repo keeps its OWN README
#   composer.lock                      -> libraries should not ship a lock file
#   .github/workflows/release.yml      -> the private publishing machinery
#   .github/workflows/secrets-check.yml-> private CI; runs on the source repo
#   .github/release/                   -> this allowlist + publisher live here
#   .github/dependabot.yml             -> dependency PRs belong on the source repo
#   build/, vendor/                    -> generated / installed artifacts

# --- library code ---
src

# --- test suite ---
tests

# --- package manifest & license ---
composer.json
LICENSE

# --- developer tooling / quality configuration ---
.gitignore
phpstan.neon
phpunit.xml
infection.json.dist

# --- public CI (runs the test suite against the published code) ---
.github/workflows/tests.yml
